kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
انعملت (form VII)
# اِنْعَمَلْتُ (inʕamaltu) /in.ʕa.mal.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِنْعَمَلَ (inʕamala)
# اِنْعَمَلْتَ (inʕamalta) /in.ʕa.mal.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْعَمَلَ (inʕamala)
# اِنْعَمَلْتِ (inʕamalti) /in.ʕa.mal.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْعَمَلَ (inʕamala)
# اِنْعَمَلَتْ (inʕamalat) /in.ʕa.ma.lat/: third-person
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
